Queries.Title: Discover cloud operations and identifier coverage
Protected account alert evidence across products
Endpoint tool execution after an impacted-user Teams alert
Observed activity after recorded remediation times
Watched app accessing explicitly protected resources
Discover Teams-related native alert titles and evidence roles

Rules.Title: Cloud App Visibility: endpoint tool after reviewed Teams alert
Rules.Description: Contextual correlation of an impacted account on a reviewed native Teams alert with a later endpoint tool execution by the same Entra user. Alert time is not contact time. This does not prove causality, remote-session success, malicious execution, or a Tier-0 pivot.
Rules.NativeOverlap: Native suspicious Teams and endpoint alerts already exist. This adds bounded same-user correlation, not a standalone tool or Teams detection.
Rules.RecommendedActions: Review the source alert and impacted-user evidence. Validate process parentage, approved support activity, and actual contact time. Pivot to existing identity alerts for Tier-0 activity; do not infer a pivot from this alert alone.

Rules.Title: Cloud App Visibility: watched app accessed protected resource
Rules.Description: An explicitly watched OAuth app generated a reviewed access operation on an explicitly protected resource. This is a tenant-specific policy signal inspired by reported mailbox collection, not a recreation of device-code or exfiltration detection. Audit activity alone does not prove successful exfiltration.
Rules.NativeOverlap: Native device-code, Graph, inbox-rule and suspicious app access detections already exist. Use only for reviewed resource/app combinations not adequately covered by native policies.
Rules.RecommendedActions: Confirm the operation outcome in source audit data, app identity, permission grant, protected resource classification and business approval. Review native alerts and other resources accessed before considering containment.
